event.name: 2 May 2020 offshore Crete earthquake and tsunami
event.tectonic_setting: Hellenic subduction zone, African plate subduction beneath the Aegean overriding plate
event.region: Offshore southern Crete, eastern Hellenic Arc, Greece

reference.title: Source modeling and spectral analysis of the Crete tsunami of 2nd May 2020 along the Hellenic Subduction Zone, offshore Greece

inversion.method: Tsunami waveform inversion of tide-gauge sea-level observations using non-negative least squares (MATLAB lsqnonneg), after Satake (1987, 2014); numerical linear shallow-water tsunami Green functions.
inversion.green_function_model: Okada (1985) elastic seafloor displacement per unit slip, propagated using linear shallow-water numerical tsunami simulations and nested bathymetry grids.
inversion.notes: Original numerical slip values are transcribed directly from published Table 2, not estimated from the colors in Fig. 9a. The source is a 4 x 3 grid of 10 x 10 km subfaults, with 40 km along strike and 30 km down dip. Table 2 lists each subfault upper-left corner (not center) and corresponding upper-left depths of 8.0, 12.1 and 16.1 km. Here patch coordinates are CALCULATED centers from the published corners by moving 5 km at azimuth 257 degrees and 5 cos(24 degrees) km at azimuth 347 degrees using WGS84 geodesics; patch center depth is estimated by adding 5 sin(24 degrees) km to the listed depth. These derived coordinates/depths are not separately published center locations. Coordinates are approximate. Reference point is the midpoint of first and last upper-left corners in the shallow row, used only for map schematic. Mw 6.67 and seismic moment are the authors' model-derived estimates; USGS lists Mw 6.6. Data type is other because the inversion used tsunami tide-gauge waveforms, not a named category in SRCGR. No smoothing constraint is explicitly established by the paper, so smoothing_constraint is null. Rupture area of 1000 km2 counts the ten nonzero-slip subfaults; the total modeled fault plane is 1200 km2.

provenance.compiled_by: Digitized for SRCGR from Heidarzadeh and Gusman (2021), Table 2
